caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, domed-lid chest that is primarily rendered in shades of yellow and gold. The chest has a decorated surface, featuring patterns created with small round metal studs arranged in symmetrical floral or geometric motifs across the top, sides, and front. The border edges of the chest are outlined with rows of metal studs. There are metallic handles on the sides of the chest, and a lock mechanism is visible at the center on the front. Near the top front edge, circular decorative metal pieces are lined up in a horizontal row. The corners of the chest display triangular patterns in a darker greenish-brown color. Shadows on the lower left provide a sense of depth, and the background is an unadorned, light off-white color. The name "Edward T. Jewett" is written in small capital letters to the right of the chest.
title: Trunk
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
